prompt: I have a folder with 8 invoice and receipt files in mixed formats (PDF, JPG, PNG) from multiple years (2022-2024), many with messy or duplicate filenames like 'invoice.pdf', 'IMG_1234.png', and some scanned images that require OCR to extract vendor, date, and amounts. Please organize these invoices by Year and Category (Software, Office Supplies, Travel), rename all files exactly to the format "YYYY-MM-DD Vendor - Invoice - Description.ext" where Description is concise and descriptive, and preserve the original files by copying instead of moving. Also generate a CSV summary called "invoice-summary.csv" at the root with columns: Date, Vendor, Invoice Number, Description, Amount, Category, and File Path. Include a text report summary printed at the end showing number of invoices processed, total amount, vendors included, and any files that needed manual review due to missing data. Filenames and folder structure must reflect the requirements exactly. Expect varied layout invoice info including handwritten dates on receipts, multiple invoice numbers in PDFs, and some files missing vendor info to be flagged. Treat all amounts as USD. Thank you.
